newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Seven killed in attack on Iranian cultural centre.
newsitem.headline: Seven killed in attack on Iranian cultural centre.

text.p: Gunmen attacked an Iranian cultural centre in the Pakistani city of Multan on Thursday, killing at least seven people, police and witnesses said on Thursday.
They said about four men armed with assault rifles had forced their way into the cultural centre at around 1 p.m. (0800 GMT) and started shooting indiscriminately.
"It seems they have shot almost everyone inside the building," one witness said. No other details were available.

Last month a crowd of Sunni Moslem militants ransacked and burned the Iranian cultural centre in Lahore, capital of Punjab province, following a bomb explosion that killed Zia-ur-Rahman Faruqi, leader of the Sipah-i-Sahaba Pakistan (SSP) faction.
SSP followers blamed Shi'ite Moslem militants for the Lahore bombing, which killed a total of 26 people and wounded about 90. Shi'ite groups denied they were involved.
